gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kanchenjunga: Bruno Ace draws every letter with a ruler-straight line of constant width, each character given its own slow beat. Kanchenjunga is the quieter partner, a drafting-pen sans whose shapes hold together even at low resolution.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kodchasan: Expressive and a bit showy, Bruno Ace leads the way. Kodchasan keeps the lower text clean and plain sans in spirit, its terminals hanging open with no calligraphic thinning, while the heading handles all the flair.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kosugi: Professional, with a wire-bent edge. Kosugi lets its open-jawed c, like a pair of pliers, run through whole words, so a long page feels crisp and lightly mechanical beside Bruno Ace.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kosugi-maru: Bruno Ace holds a ruler-drawn line of constant width. Kosugi Maru then lights up the text like neon tubing, a sans-serif with stroke ends set far apart, doing the quiet work that the heading skips.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-lato: Bruno Ace has a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, every counter linked to the space outside. Lato follows with wide s curves barely curled in, a sans-serif that stays low-key and clean.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-libre-franklin: Bruno Ace draws a marker-like line of constant width, with counters that stay connected to the space around each letter. Libre Franklin, a sans-serif with a splayed c terminal, settles in underneath.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-livvic: Approachable is what Livvic brings, with no stress in its curves and a generous opening in the c. And Bruno Ace sits above it, its ruler-drawn line giving the sans-serif text a firmer, more expressive header.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-m-plus-2: Approachable and professional, M PLUS 2 is the steady one here. Bruno Ace holds the spotlight with its ruler-drawn, lingering rhythm, while M PLUS 2 keeps a gaping c opening and one fixed nib width.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: M PLUS Rounded 1c reads neutral and friendly, its terminals stopping short of curling back in. And Bruno Ace above it keeps joins as thick as its strokes, so a long page moves from bold to soft without a jolt.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-manjari: Sharp-edged and showy up top. Manjari takes over below with wide, unclosed curves and a steady, unvarying line, so Bruno Ace's ruler-drawn lettering gets a friendly, professional partner.
